question: What ritual placement and action are prescribed involving the Śivā-skull?
premises: A Śivā-skull is to be placed on the right
The placement is done as a preparatory act
inference: Having placed the Śivā-skull on the right, one should perform worship.
uncertainties: The precise identity or preparation of śivā+muṇḍaṃ is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Having placed the Śivā-skull on the right, one should perform worship.
